jaime: FYI we're planning a staging cutover tomorrow 03:30 UTC. this wave touches API header-splitting + router parse-buffer tweak + console routing rules. proposing to pin runtime for the window and hold the rollout until prewarm + quick canary.
linh: +1 to pin. noticed router backoff in a previous run when header fields >3.5k bytes. small shard (shard-9) saw KV evictions spike.
linh: logs: ```
[staging-router] 2024-11-05T00:05:14Z WARN parse_buffer_overflow id=shard-9
[staging-runtime] 2024-11-05T00:05:15Z INFO kv_eviction count=31 reason=header_pressure
```
arjun: recommend runtime v2.15.0 pinned (has the header-buffer guard) + disable console-new-split FF in staging during the warmup. add a short-lived alert on `kv_eviction_rate` and `router.parse_overflow`.
olivia: rollback criteria suggestion: sustained 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.02 for 5m OR session.reset_rate doubles. also abort if canary p95 >600ms for 10m.
jaime: sounds good. i'll run the hold once we agree on pin/version and prewarm window. proposed warmup 20m before cutover, gradual 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 15m.
linh: i've added Grafana temp panels: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/parse/quick-check . panels: `router.parse_overflow`, `kv_eviction_rate`, `api.header_size_p95`.
arjun: deploy-bot commands below. i'll wait for :thumbsup: and then place hold.
arjun: ```
/deploy hold staging --reason "router-parse-buffer-safety" --by arjun --until 1763154500
/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-9 --type cache --by arjun
```
deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2024-11-05T03:30Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
olivia: add a small QA checklist in the release doc: 1) run smoke with header-heavy payloads, 2) confirm no parse_overflow logged, 3) confirm eviction_rate <0.01, 4) check session continuity.
linh: smoke run now (header payload ~4.2k): 5xx at 1.2% on first pass, reran after a small router config tweak -> 0.2%. posting snippets.
linh: ```
[smoke-1] 5xx_rate=0.012
[smoke-2] 5xx_rate=0.002
```
jaime: ok let's pin runtime v2.15.0 and place the hold. will keep console FF off for staging. arjun can you place hold?
arjun: running `/deploy hold staging --reason "router-parse-buffer-safety"` now.
deploy-bot: hold placed by arjun at 1763150155 (reason: router-parse-buffer-safety)
olivia: good. arjun please run the prewarm 20m before and then signal me when you start traffic ramp. i'll watch grafana and call lift.
arjun: reminder: run `/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-9 --type cache` to warm caches and KV. deploy-bot will report when prewarm completes.
deploy-bot: prewarm accepted; started cache-warm on shard-9. ETA ~12m.
linh: i'll keep traces on for 72h and watch for parse overflow. tagging eng-infra for any network buffer knobs if needed.
jaime: release notes snippet: "Pinned runtime v2.15.0 for staging window; disabled console-new-split FF in staging; added transient alerts on router.parse_overflow and kv_eviction_rate; prewarm scheduled."
olivia: lift criteria: 20m stable canary with 5xx <0.2% and kv_eviction_rate <0.01 and p95 <450ms. otherwise rollback.
arjun: prewarm complete (deploy-bot id 1763150299). starting warmup ramp 20m before.
deploy-bot: prewarm finished at 1763150299.
linh: quick smoke after prewarm: 5xx 0.15%, kv_eviction_rate 0.006. looks within thresholds.
jaime: thanks. i'll hold until we hit 20m stable then unhold. please post only short status updates in this thread so oncall can track.
arjun: will post release id when unhold. thanks all.
